name: Trim's Infinite Factory
author: Trim
description: Adds Auraline, a prismatic solid condensed by bringing Prismite and Prismaline into contact. Auraline is a universal feedstock: shake it for Sand, drop it through a Kinetic Press for Redsand, burn it for Copper, smelt it for Lava, or bring it into contact with Water to get Moonhop.
